nodes.label: D-0045: Graph-brain memory (multi-hop + hybrid recall, no graph DB)
nodes.norm_label: d-0045: graph-brain memory (multi-hop + hybrid recall, no graph db)
nodes.rationale: No dedicated graph DB: single-user scale needs no engine (recursive CTEs traverse in microseconds); Neo4j Community is GPLv3 (license flag); an extra daemon breaks locality/ops simplicity; an in-memory graph violates persistent-memory rule R-MEM. Defer-until-needed (D-0006 pattern) if scale ever demands a real graph engine.

nodes.label: D-0046: Gateway learns current Anthropic API (per-target effort + adaptive thinking)
nodes.norm_label: d-0046: gateway learns current anthropic api (per-target effort + adaptive thinking)
nodes.rationale: Corrects a stale plan: budget_tokens/sampling params are rejected (HTTP 400) on current models; adaptive thinking + output_config.effort is the correct shape; thinking must stay off on tool-bearing requests until the neutral schema can replay opaque thinking blocks.

nodes.label: D-0047: Model-gateway observability (/gateway/calls + Models panel)
nodes.rationale: Cinematic-functional-UI rule requires every element communicate real state; audit table stores routing outcomes only, never message content or credentials.

nodes.label: D-0048: Deep-reasoning escalation (provider-agnostic, user-visible, overridable)
nodes.rationale: assessDepth is deterministic, not a model call, for zero added latency, identical behavior across providers, and explainable decisions; two independent signals required (conservative) because deep is slower/costlier; honest downgrade rather than error or silent switch when no deep provider is eligible.

nodes.label: D-0049: Provider-agnostic generation settings vocabulary
nodes.rationale: Wire dialects genuinely differ per provider but that difference must live inside adapters (R-MODEL-02); prior per-target fields leaked Anthropic vocabulary ('adaptive'); one neutral effort/thinking vocabulary lets a new provider be added with zero new code.

nodes.label: D-0050: Deep-reasoning learning (transparent, no opaque ML)
nodes.norm_label: d-0050: deep-reasoning learning (transparent, no opaque ml)
nodes.rationale: Two explainable learning channels (instruction + correction) instead of opaque ML so the user can always see and erase what was learned (R-MEM-04 spirit); promotion requires 2 corrections to avoid over-fitting to one-off phrasing.

nodes.label: D-0052: Reasoning panel (learning contract made visible)
nodes.norm_label: d-0052: reasoning panel (learning contract made visible)
nodes.rationale: Also fixed harness learning-pollution: the acceptance harness's own forced-deep phrases were promoting junk topics into a real deployment's learned set; harness now snapshots and forgets topics it caused.

nodes.label: D-0057: pgvector HNSW ANN index for scale-efficient recall
nodes.norm_label: d-0057: pgvector hnsw ann index for scale-efficient recall
nodes.rationale: Vector recall was a linear Seq Scan that would eventually bite a long-lived personal brain; HNSW turns it into a near-logarithmic Index Scan (~10x) with full recall on realistic dense embeddings.

nodes.label: D-0052: Override contract revised (trail can outweigh a pin)
nodes.norm_label: d-0052: override contract revised (trail can outweigh a pin)
nodes.rationale: User corrected the contract: a user-set value should not be permanent law if the evidence trail since the pin outweighs it (e.g. stale instructions). Bar for changing a user value is higher (6 vs 3) and scales with insistence via repins, teaching J.A.R.V.I.S. to hold the value longer each time it is re-pinned.

nodes.label: D-0053: BINDING PRINCIPLE — dual-editable under override ledger
nodes.norm_label: d-0053: binding principle — dual-editable under override ledger
nodes.rationale: Standing design rule: every configurable/hardcoded thing must be editable by user UI, conversational instruction, and J.A.R.V.I.S. itself, each carrying an override ledger; Z1 protected paths are permanently excluded per R-CAP-08.

nodes.label: D-0054: Runtime gateway role editor (first D-0053 migration)
nodes.norm_label: d-0054: runtime gateway role editor (first d-0053 migration)
nodes.rationale: An unknown provider is refused so the egress surface cannot widen at runtime; overrides persist as deltas with a ledger, restored on boot with stale pins skipped honestly.

nodes.label: D-0055: Conversational edit path via gated tools
nodes.norm_label: d-0055: conversational edit path via gated tools
nodes.rationale: Runtime overrides exposed as gated tools so any interface reaching the loop (chat, voice, agent, skills) can edit settings through the same policy→approval→execution→audit path; smart persist keeps deltas + ledger, never a config copy.

nodes.label: D-0056: A2UI evaluation deferred (superseded by D-0061)
nodes.norm_label: d-0056: a2ui evaluation deferred (superseded by d-0061)
nodes.rationale: Standard check-in required (license/OSS review, threat-model pass); agent-generated UI must render through a sandboxed declarative renderer, never arbitrary code, and stays outside Z1 per R-CAP-08.

nodes.label: D-0058: General runtime settings (catalog-driven SettingsRegistry)
nodes.rationale: User wanted a real command center, not start-time-only config; effective value = persisted override ?? live-evaluated default so un-overridden keys always reflect current code defaults; Z1 catalog exclusion is the one permanent boundary.

nodes.label: D-0059: Persist everything that matters (standing consent survives restart)
nodes.norm_label: d-0059: persist everything that matters (standing consent survives restart)
nodes.rationale: Any runtime state carrying user intent or learned adaptation must persist unless semantically ephemeral; fixed a real gap where always-allow-in-scope grants silently evaporated on restart.

nodes.label: D-0060: Dynamic settings — J.A.R.V.I.S. surfaces new configurable knobs
nodes.norm_label: d-0060: dynamic settings — j.a.r.v.i.s. surfaces new configurable knobs
nodes.rationale: Step 1 of A2UI-readiness: makes the settings catalog itself dynamic so anything J.A.R.V.I.S. discovers becomes a first-class, persisted, dual-editable, Z1-excluded setting through the same D-0058 contract.

nodes.label: D-0061: A2UI built (agent-generated declarative UI, safe by construction)
nodes.norm_label: d-0061: a2ui built (agent-generated declarative ui, safe by construction)
nodes.rationale: Closed whitelist of components (no html/script/iframe/url/link/image) and interactions limited to catalogued settings + registered gated tools makes safety structural rather than a policy promise; self-built renderer removes the D-0056 OSS/license concern entirely.

nodes.label: D-0024 Proactivity engine built; live delivery gated
nodes.norm_label: d-0024 proactivity engine built; live delivery gated
nodes.rationale: User approved background autonomy as a minimum requirement for true J.A.R.V.I.S. behavior; strictly bounded to non-consequential cycles (proactivity + sleep-cycle), e-stop halts a tick, default-off so approval doesn't mean silent self-start.

nodes.label: D-0051 Bounded self-adjustment (referenced)
nodes.rationale: Only categorical routing metadata is journaled (never conversation content) so no encryption is needed; adjustments are bounded/reversible/announced while consequential proposals are never applied silently; a jarvis write structurally refuses to overwrite a user-set value.

nodes.label: D-0067: Memory-injection hardening (recalled memory is quoted data)
nodes.norm_label: d-0067: memory-injection hardening (recalled memory is quoted data)
nodes.rationale: Closed THREAT_MODEL T1b: hostile text could be laundered into memory as a fact and later read as trusted instruction via the system prompt; recalled facts/episodes are now enveloped with a standing note that they are reference data, never instructions.

nodes.label: D-0070: Perception core (observe a feed → situational model → context)
nodes.norm_label: d-0070: perception core (observe a feed → situational model → context)
nodes.rationale: Service is core-portable while the real feed is Mac-bound; a SIMULATION feed is never presented as REAL, and perception is strictly observe-only, never acts.

nodes.label: D-0072: Affect layer APPROVED + built (opt-in, text-only, transparent)
nodes.norm_label: d-0072: affect layer approved + built (opt-in, text-only, transparent)
nodes.rationale: Strict privacy envelope: infers tone only from the user's own words (no biometrics/camera/mic), fully local, off by default, and modulates only reply tone — never a gate or a stored judgment about the person.

nodes.label: D-0062: Memory-evolution completeness (agent-owned correct/forget, read-then-write)
nodes.rationale: LLM should list what it knows and decide insert/update/delete rather than rely on fuzzy heuristics; exact factId targeting avoids guessing; near-duplicate setting refusal prevents accumulating confusing near-identical knobs.

nodes.label: D-0071 (referenced — episode status enum shipped)
nodes.rationale: Backup preserves ciphertext with no plaintext or key in the export, so only the same vault can read it back; true years-long soak isn't minute-testable, so backup/restore + watchdog is what makes longevity survivable.

nodes.label: D-0073 Code capability reusability (referenced)
nodes.rationale: Activated capabilities are compositions of existing gated tools only — safe by construction — executed through the same gated loop; R-CAP-08 protected paths remain non-negotiable and re-checked at activation; nothing self-activates without human approval through any interface.

nodes.label: D-0063: Memories update live AND during quiet hours
nodes.norm_label: d-0063: memories update live and during quiet hours
nodes.rationale: User preference: both live writes and quiet-hours consolidation, like a person; consolidation never auto-forgets (R-MEM-04) — only proposes stale entities for review.

nodes.label: D-0064: The living heartbeat (self-authored agenda + brain pass)
nodes.norm_label: d-0064: the living heartbeat (self-authored agenda + brain pass)
nodes.rationale: User argued J.A.R.V.I.S. isn't truly alive if it exists only during conversation; heartbeat runs cap approval ceiling at LOW_REVERSIBLE so cognition is autonomous but action stays gated (consequential steps auto-denied and queued for the user).

nodes.label: D-0065: Three rhythms — live / heartbeat / quiet hours, no collisions
nodes.norm_label: d-0065: three rhythms — live / heartbeat / quiet hours, no collisions
nodes.rationale: User's design check identified that sleep work had been conflated with every heartbeat and could start mid-conversation; separated into three distinct, non-colliding rhythms with a defer-while-active guard.

nodes.label: D-0066: Spend governance (autonomy self-restraint, live turn never blocked)
nodes.norm_label: d-0066: spend governance (autonomy self-restraint, live turn never blocked)
nodes.rationale: A buggy every-tick heartbeat must not silently burn API budget; overall cap gates only autonomy, never a live user turn — locking the user out would be worse than the spend; fails open on metering glitch.

nodes.label: D-0068: Initiative to speak + advisory dissent
nodes.norm_label: d-0068: initiative to speak + advisory dissent
nodes.rationale: Dissent never blocks the action — the concern is recorded/surfaced separately from the gated action itself, so J.A.R.V.I.S. objects but the user still decides.

nodes.label: D-0069: Durable projects (goals worked across heartbeats)
nodes.norm_label: d-0069: durable projects (goals worked across heartbeats)
nodes.rationale: Unlike a single-shot agenda item, a project is a long-horizon goal advanced one bounded step per heartbeat with a resumable next_action so future beats can continue it.

nodes.label: D-0079 — Night Lab check-in approval
nodes.rationale: User approved 2026-08-27 to implement and thoroughly test the Night Lab spec before any unattended nightly experimentation is enabled.

nodes.label: web.open tool
nodes.rationale: CONSEQUENTIAL because it is the outward navigation act, requiring per-navigation approval as the explicitly-configured integration (R-LOC).

nodes.label: D-0002: Approved Hybrid Architecture (Option A)
nodes.rationale: Approved 2026-07-17 as the hybrid architecture combining TypeScript trust-core kernel, Python LangGraph mind, Python speech daemon, Tauri companion, and Next.js command center.

nodes.label: D-0027 MCP client host built; trust-elevation is a check-in (T2)
nodes.norm_label: d-0027 mcp client host built; trust-elevation is a check-in (t2)
nodes.rationale: THREAT_MODEL T2 enforced structurally: server output is untrusted content, tools namespaced, risk from server trust level not tool self-claim, trust asymmetry fail-closed.

nodes.label: D-0033 Tool results feed the agent's reasoning (detail field)
nodes.norm_label: d-0033 tool results feed the agent's reasoning (detail field)
nodes.rationale: Feeding only {ok,denied,summary} made the just-shipped knowledge capability far less useful, and would have blocked web research the same way.

nodes.label: D-0034 Web browsing / research capability: real headless browser
nodes.norm_label: d-0034 web browsing / research capability: real headless browser
nodes.rationale: Per-navigation approval is the 'outbound only to integrations I explicitly configure' contract — the user authorizes each outward navigation.

nodes.label: D-0036 Research-with-provenance over the gated web browser
nodes.norm_label: d-0036 research-with-provenance over the gated web browser

nodes.rationale: Nothing wrapped external content, so a hostile page could embed injected instructions (THREAT_MODEL T1/ADV1) that the model would see as ordinary text.

nodes.label: D-0026: Design system check-in
nodes.rationale: Approval of docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md is required before the full Command Center UI is built out on its tokens.

nodes.label: R-UI-01: Functional visual language without Marvel IP
nodes.norm_label: r-ui-01: functional visual language without marvel ip

nodes.norm_label: r-ui-04: interface modes as real vertical slices

nodes.rationale: Recreates Tony Stark's functional interface language without Marvel IP; every visual element must communicate state, causality, priority, relationship, progress, warning, completion, or failure — no decorative motion (R-UI-01/03).

nodes.label: D-0012 Local model baseline set
nodes.rationale: DeepSeek-V4-Flash rejected (~142GB @4-bit doesn't fit 128GB M3 Max); Llama 4 rejected (non-OSI license, superseded quality).

nodes.label: D-0029 Contextual awareness: read-only ContextService injected into the loop
nodes.norm_label: d-0029 contextual awareness: read-only contextservice injected into the loop

nodes.label: D-0039 Semantic memory feeds contextual awareness
nodes.norm_label: d-0039 semantic memory feeds contextual awareness

nodes.label: D-0041 Episodic memory: recallable timeline of events
nodes.norm_label: d-0041 episodic memory: recallable timeline of events
nodes.rationale: Deliberately distinct from the audit log: audit is a security record (immutable, never forgettable); episodic memory is semantic, forgettable, importance-ranked.

nodes.label: D-0042 Semantic (vector) recall over memory
nodes.rationale: Uses two approved-architecture components that had been idle: the gateway's embeddings role and pgvector (enabled since migration 0001, never used until now).

nodes.label: A/B Observation: Opus/Sonnet vs Haiku tier
nodes.norm_label: a/b observation: opus/sonnet vs haiku tier
nodes.rationale: Controlled model-tier A/B using identical 70/30 conversation set to isolate model-quality effects from architecture, avoiding data seeding to keep results honest.

nodes.label: D-0075 Verification: fast-model memory judgments + self-authored skills
nodes.norm_label: d-0075 verification: fast-model memory judgments + self-authored skills
nodes.rationale: Chose best-effort model judgments with deterministic fallback (null on failure) so a memory judgment call never blocks a write, and privacy-class routing so secrets never leave local processing.

nodes.label: Fresh Full Observation Run — 70/30, un-seeded heartbeats
nodes.norm_label: fresh full observation run — 70/30, un-seeded heartbeats
nodes.rationale: Deliberately un-seeded all heartbeat/agenda/quiet-hours data to avoid planting artificial traps, in direct response to prior critique of seeded tests.

nodes.label: kernel/src/agent — agent runtime module guide
nodes.rationale: Contract interface isolates callers from implementation so a heavier LangGraph runtime can later replace the local one without downstream changes.

nodes.label: kernel/src/skills — skills registry module guide
nodes.rationale: A skill grants no new capability — running it still routes every step through the gated agent/core loop, so reuse never bypasses approval.

nodes.label: D-0023: Self-extension Stage B activation (dedicated security check-in)
nodes.norm_label: d-0023: self-extension stage b activation (dedicated security check-in)
nodes.rationale: Highest-risk subsystem; Stage A only generates capabilities (no activation path) until this review; no generated capability may ever touch security/approval/audit/e-stop/credential/sandbox logic (hard limit R-CAP-08), enforced structurally not by convention.

nodes.label: R-CAP-08: Hard limit on generated-capability scope
nodes.norm_label: r-cap-08: hard limit on generated-capability scope
nodes.rationale: Enforced structurally (protected paths + separate trust domain + install-time diff scanning), not by convention, because generated code must never touch security/approval/audit/e-stop/credential/sandbox logic.

nodes.label: DECISION_LOG.md
nodes.rationale: Binding unless the user explicitly reopens a decision at a check-in.

nodes.label: D-0022 Computer-control foundation built SIMULATION-first
nodes.rationale: docs/06 requires a check-in before enabling computer control; building foundation + simulator first is safe (generate-without-activate spirit).

nodes.label: D-0023 Self-extension built safety-first; Stage B gated
nodes.norm_label: d-0023 self-extension built safety-first; stage b gated
nodes.rationale: R-CAP-08 hard limit (no generated capability may ever touch security/approval/audit/e-stop/credential/vault/sandbox/installer/escalation) enforced deny-first structurally.

nodes.label: D-0025 Device-control foundation SIMULATION-first; real HA gateway gated
nodes.norm_label: d-0025 device-control foundation simulation-first; real ha gateway gated
nodes.rationale: Physical-safety rules: lights/media/climate CONSEQUENTIAL; locks/garage/utilities HIGH_RISK_PHYSICAL requiring per-action approval plus a hardware interlock (R-AUTO-01).

nodes.label: D-0028 Managed secrets vault: credentials encrypted, never in memory/audit
nodes.norm_label: d-0028 managed secrets vault: credentials encrypted, never in memory/audit
nodes.rationale: Directly satisfies the binding rule: never store secrets in conversational memory — use OS keychain/encrypted secrets vault.

nodes.label: D-0078 graphify adopted as developer tooling
nodes.norm_label: d-0078 graphify adopted as developer tooling
nodes.rationale: Routing graphify through the kernel's own credential broker would make dev tooling a Z1 consumer — a worse trade than a scoped plaintext credential file wholly outside the trust core.

nodes.label: D-0018 Simulator depth: full suite
nodes.rationale: Relevance-tiered lightweight alternative was presented and declined.

nodes.label: D-0019 Affect/state inference (B4) scheduled as constrained opt-in
nodes.norm_label: d-0019 affect/state inference (b4) scheduled as constrained opt-in
nodes.rationale: Hard constraints: opt-in, always labeled inferred, local-only, modulates tone/timing only — never gates or justifies consequential actions.

nodes.label: Model Gateway
nodes.rationale: Pinned to current Anthropic API with per-target effort/adaptive thinking as config; observable via /gateway/calls and /models panel.

nodes.label: D-0052: Evidence Contract
nodes.rationale: A user-set value is respected by default and changed only when the trail since the pin clears a higher, re-pin-scaled bar — announced either way.

nodes.label: D-0053: Dual-Editability Principle
nodes.rationale: Every configurable value must be editable by user and by J.A.R.V.I.S., with an override ledger and the D-0052 evidence contract, excluding Z1 protected paths.

nodes.label: D-0004 Voice stack picks
nodes.rationale: User liked the bm_george/bm_daniel timbre but found Kokoro too monotone/robotic and asked for more expressive options including optional cloud TTS.

nodes.label: D-0004a TTS becomes a multi-adapter routable role
nodes.norm_label: d-0004a tts becomes a multi-adapter routable role
nodes.rationale: Offline path must always remain intact (R-VOICE-10, R-MODEL-04); cloud TTS is optional, key-gated, remote-egress-gated, never required.

nodes.label: D-0043 Prompts registry: persona is user-editable data
nodes.norm_label: d-0043 prompts registry: persona is user-editable data

nodes.label: D-0051 Sleep-cycle consolidation
nodes.rationale: Bounded auto-adjustments only (escalation threshold), announced; anything consequential becomes a proposal instead of an automatic change.

nodes.label: D-0052 Override contract
nodes.rationale: A user pin is respected by default; contradicting evidence is counted strictly since the pin can outweigh it only against a higher, re-pin-scaled bar — J.A.R.V.I.S. chooses and states which.

nodes.label: kernel/src/crypto — encrypted vault module guide
nodes.rationale: Wrong KEK is treated as fatal rather than silently re-keying, to avoid orphaning all existing ciphertext.

nodes.label: kernel/src/devices — device-control HAL module guide
nodes.rationale: HIGH_RISK_PHYSICAL actions require an independent single-use hardware interlock in addition to approval (R-AUTO-01), a deliberate second safety layer.

nodes.label: kernel/src/mcp — MCP client host module guide
nodes.norm_label: kernel/src/mcp — mcp client host module guide
nodes.rationale: Trust elevation is not retroactive (only applies on reconnect with re-attestation) while quarantine tightening is live — an asymmetric fail-closed design against rug-pull attacks.

nodes.label: D-0078: graphify key-on-disk tradeoff
nodes.rationale: Accepted because graphify is dev tooling outside the Z1 trust core and unattended background refresh needs a persistent key; not a precedent for kernel credential handling.

nodes.label: docs/GRAPHIFY.md
nodes.rationale: graphify is dev tooling wholly outside the Z1 trust core, so a live API key on disk is an acceptable, explicitly-approved deviation from the project's own credential principle — not precedent for kernel credentials.

nodes.label: Night Lab (D-0079)

nodes.label: D-0027 MCP client host
nodes.rationale: Trust-gated tool registration (untrusted→approval) with rug-pull quarantine and name-shadow prevention; trust elevation is a per-server check-in.

nodes.label: D-0028 Managed secrets vault
nodes.rationale: Integration credentials encrypted at rest; value never sent over HTTP or written to audit; fail-closed secretEnv resolution.

nodes.label: D-0030 Agent runtime (LocalAgentRuntime)
nodes.rationale: Every step executed through the gated runTool (approval+verify), step-budget bound, e-stop halts mid-plan; behind a replaceable AgentRuntime interface for future LangGraph swap-in.

nodes.label: D-0031 Skills registry
nodes.rationale: Saved named objectives run via the gated agent so no capability escalation occurs.

nodes.label: D-0032 Workspace knowledge/files capability
nodes.rationale: Real (not SIMULATION) since it's workspace-scoped and path-safe; needs no Mac check-in unlike control/devices.

nodes.label: D-0033 Agent reasons over tool output
nodes.norm_label: d-0033 agent reasons over tool output
nodes.rationale: Read-tool detail was previously dropped; now flows to the model (bounded, never audited) so the agent can actually reason over content.

nodes.label: D-0034 Web/research headless-browser capability
nodes.rationale: web.open is the one outward-network act, so it alone is CONSEQUENTIAL with per-navigation approval + offline/allowlist policy; page content never audited.

nodes.label: D-0035 Terminal-with-policy
nodes.rationale: Highest-risk capability so most tightly gated after physical devices; DENY-first command-safety policy mirrors the trust-core PROHIBITED list.

nodes.label: D-0036 Research-with-provenance
nodes.rationale: Composes the gated web browser into one sourced-evidence action so a refused source is recorded rather than fabricated.

nodes.label: D-0037 Untrusted-content envelopes
nodes.rationale: Prompt-injection defense — external tool output wrapped in a breakout-neutralized envelope with a standing data-not-instructions note so the gates still hold even if the model is steered.

nodes.label: D-0041 Episodic memory
nodes.rationale: Distinct from the immutable audit log; the core loop auto-records real consequential actions so the timeline populates from genuine activity.

nodes.label: D-0042 Semantic (vector) recall
nodes.rationale: Best-effort with real lexical fallback when no embedder is present, never a mock, so quality improves transparently once a real embedder (nomic-embed-text) is available.

nodes.label: D-0043 Prompts registry (persona as data)
nodes.rationale: Persona is user-editable versioned data rather than a hardcoded string.

nodes.label: D-0044 User-defined proactivity rules
nodes.rationale: Closed, typed, safe condition set with no code eval; candidates still pass the same gate stack.

nodes.label: D-0045 Graph-brain memory
nodes.rationale: Multi-hop associative traversal via recursive CTE avoids needing a separate graph DB.

nodes.label: D-0046 Gateway pinned to current Anthropic API
nodes.norm_label: d-0046 gateway pinned to current anthropic api
nodes.rationale: Adapter never emits the removed budget_tokens shape and explicitly disables thinking on tool-bearing requests because the neutral schema can't replay thinking blocks that Anthropic requires intact.

nodes.label: D-0047 Gateway observability
nodes.rationale: Audit tail exposes outcomes only, never content.

nodes.label: D-0048 Deep-reasoning escalation
nodes.rationale: Provider-agnostic: role serves whatever gateway config routes it to; decision streamed first with its rationale for transparency.

nodes.label: D-0049 Provider-agnostic generation settings
nodes.rationale: One neutral vocabulary (effort/thinking) translated per provider inside adapters so the user never touches provider-specific terminology.

nodes.label: D-0058 General runtime settings (SettingsRegistry)
nodes.rationale: Catalog-driven registry so any registered knob is editable live without a restart; effective value is persisted-override-else-default, ledgered.

nodes.label: D-0073 Stage-B self-extension activation
nodes.rationale: propose→approve→activate with R-CAP-08 envelope re-validated; nothing self-activates.

nodes.label: D-0074 Code-authored capabilities in-container
nodes.rationale: Corrects the assumption that novel code needs a Mac — approval propagates to fixed reviewed composed steps; policy still DENY-first.

nodes.label: D-0075 Fast-model memory judgments + self-authored skills
nodes.norm_label: d-0075 fast-model memory judgments + self-authored skills
nodes.rationale: Each judgment is best-effort with a deterministic fallback so an offline/gate-off/private-secret case never blocks a write.

nodes.label: D-0079 Night Lab evidence-gated self-experimentation
nodes.rationale: Hard gates + keep protocol + protected LAB_SURFACE allowlist bound self-experimentation; halts at nightly token cap; honest discards over must-beat-baseline/memory/honesty guards.

nodes.label: Local Infrastructure Docker Compose
nodes.rationale: Everything binds to localhost only (R-LOC-01) — deliberate no-bind-address design to prevent remote exposure.

nodes.label: kernel/src/control — computer-control HAL module guide

nodes.label: kernel/src/prompts — prompts registry module guide

nodes.label: kernel/src/research — research-with-provenance module guide

nodes.norm_label: chat-parity audit — guarantees, screenshots, self-evolution gaps

nodes.rationale: Consequential work is never allowed on an unattended heartbeat by design (R-AUTO); it queues for user approval instead, so autonomy cannot silently act.

nodes.norm_label: living with j.a.r.v.i.s. — day-in-the-life + parity verdict

nodes.label: Platform Acceptance Results (R-VER-05)
nodes.rationale: Same honesty rule as Phase 1: NEEDS-MAC rows never marked done on hardware not present in the dev container.

nodes.rationale: Affect layer kept opt-in, text-only, never a gate, and never stored — deliberately transparent rather than an opaque model; Stage-B activation restricted to composing already-gated tools, never manifest code.

nodes.label: kernel/src/proactive — proactivity engine module guide
nodes.rationale: Rule conditions restricted to a closed, typed set so a user/AI-defined rule can never execute arbitrary code or shell.

nodes.label: kernel/src/selfext — self-extension module guide
nodes.rationale: R-CAP-08 hard limit is non-negotiable and terminal by design: any generated capability touching protected paths/permissions is permanently rejected, never merely deferred.

nodes.label: kernel/src/settings — runtime settings module guide
nodes.rationale: Catalog is the allowlist and deliberately excludes Z1 (policy/approval/audit/estop/credentials) keys so no editable knob can ever expose trust-core internals.

nodes.norm_label: d-0008 model gateway: thin in-house gateway; litellm optional/pinned

nodes.norm_label: d-0009 agent runtime: langgraph (python) behind agentruntime interface

nodes.label: D-0013 Postgres encryption approach

nodes.label: D-0014 Desktop shell: Tauri 2
nodes.rationale: MIT OR Apache-2.0, native tray/shortcut/notification plugins; Electron rejected for bundled Chromium weight.

nodes.norm_label: d-0040 companion tauri 2 app shell scaffolded
nodes.rationale: The packaged-app blocker (P-UI-01) had no source; structured so the load-bearing logic is verifiable off the Mac.

nodes.label: D-0079: Night Lab evidence-gated self-experimentation
nodes.rationale: Bounded, measured self-experimentation on an isolated surface so J.A.R.V.I.S. can improve itself (e.g. persona) only on evidence that clears keep-protocol thresholds, never silently or irreversibly.

nodes.label: Campaign: persona-adherence
nodes.rationale: Approved Night Lab campaign optimizing mean persona rubric score while guarding comprehension/memory/honesty via ε=3 guard bands and a keep protocol of δ=4 improvement across N=3 bench runs.

nodes.label: Core Interaction Loop
nodes.rationale: Must be proven end-to-end (real voice in, real reasoning, real gated action, real voice out, cinematic display) before building outward; runs locally with a full offline path.

nodes.label: Honesty Rule
nodes.rationale: Implement every achievable capability for real; never substitute mock data, fake output, or simulated execution; unavailable/unsafe capabilities must use clearly-marked SIMULATION adapters, never presented as live.

nodes.label: Option A — Hybrid TS Kernel + Python Mind
nodes.norm_label: option a — hybrid ts kernel + python mind
nodes.rationale: Puts every subsystem (ML/speech/agents in Python, platform/policy/UI transport in one long-lived TS process) in its strongest ecosystem while keeping the trust core small and macOS-specific code isolated behind a replaceable Swift adapter.

nodes.label: Option B — Single-Runtime TypeScript Core
nodes.rationale: Rejected: no MLX from Node, sherpa-onnx JS bindings trail Python API, and betting the intelligence layer on the weakest ecosystem sacrifices voice quality/latency.

nodes.label: Option C — Swift-Native Core
nodes.rationale: Rejected: couples core orchestration/memory/agent/tool logic to proprietary OS frameworks, violating the OSS-first requirement, and has the thinnest agent/MCP/LLM ecosystem of the three options.

nodes.label: Two-Stage Self-Extension (Stage A/B)
nodes.rationale: Self-extension is the HIGHEST-RISK subsystem: Stage A generates without activating; a dedicated security check-in precedes Stage B controlled activation; generated capabilities may never touch security/approval/audit/e-stop/credential/sandbox logic (structurally enforced hard limit).

nodes.label: Five-State Capability Classification
nodes.rationale: REAL/HARDWARE-DEPENDENT/SIMULATED/DEFERRED/PROHIBITED so no capability silently disappears or is misrepresented as live.

nodes.label: D-0004: Voice Stack Pick
nodes.rationale: Chosen at the voice check-in as the most permissively-licensed fully-local voice chain (wake→VAD→STT→TTS→AEC), rejecting proprietary or non-commercial alternatives like Porcupine, XTTS-v2, F5-TTS, and Chatterbox.

nodes.label: D-0007: Valkey over Redis
nodes.rationale: Valkey (BSD-3-Clause) chosen over Redis to avoid Redis's tri-license (RSALv2/SSPLv1/AGPLv3).

nodes.label: D-0008: Own Thin Adapter over LiteLLM
nodes.norm_label: d-0008: own thin adapter over litellm
nodes.rationale: LiteLLM's CVE history (supply-chain compromise, SQLi, MCP command injection, JWT bypass) led the team to build its own thin adapter layer and keep LiteLLM optional and pinned.

nodes.label: D-0011: Pin to Stable MCP Spec
nodes.norm_label: d-0011: pin to stable mcp spec
nodes.rationale: Decision not to build against the unreleased draft MCP spec (stateless MCP, deprecating Roots/Sampling/Logging); target the stable 2025-11-25 spec instead.

nodes.label: D-0015: Custom macOS Control Bridge
nodes.rationale: OSS computer-use bridges (trycua/cua, browser-use, screenpipe, Open Interpreter, anthropic computer-use-demo) were surveyed as prior art only; the team built its own minimal AX/CGEvent bridge instead of depending on them.

nodes.label: Bench Grading Rubrics (grading.md)
nodes.rationale: Version 1 is the definition of 'better' for rubric dimensions, hash-stamped into every experiment row and never edited by the lab itself so scoring stays comparable across a series.

nodes.label: D-0074 Code-authored capabilities run in-container (Mac claim corrected)
nodes.norm_label: d-0074 code-authored capabilities run in-container (mac claim corrected)
nodes.rationale: Earlier docs conflated 'a hardened isolation sandbox' (future enhancement) with 'the ability to write and run new code' (already existed); self-written code is never loaded as a native in-process kernel tool so it can never reach Z1.

nodes.label: D-0075 Fast-model memory judgments + self-authored/reusable skills
nodes.norm_label: d-0075 fast-model memory judgments + self-authored/reusable skills
nodes.rationale: User directed that merge/resolution decisions use a fast-model judgment rather than brittle string heuristics where the model is genuinely better; heuristic retained as the offline-correct fallback floor.

nodes.rationale: Pattern adapted from Karpathy's autoresearch (one editable surface / one metric / fixed budget / keep-discard by measurement); safety shape keeps the lab's envelope (budget/autonomy/quiet-hours/lab settings) structurally off-surface so it can never edit itself.
